title: Cask23DistilleryProfile
description: Schema for Cask 23 Project Zero verified distillery governance profiles.

officialName.description: The officially verified name of the distillery.

entityType.description: The category resolved during entity reconciliation.

country.description: Country where the facility is physically located.

region.description: Specific whisky region where applicable. Optional for world whisky; never manufacture a region.

founded.description: The year the distillery was established.

owner.description: Current parent company or owner entity.

location.description: Physical geographic coordinates or postal address details.

operationalStatus.description: The current operational state of the production facility.

production.description: Factual technical production specifications backed by credible evidence.

waterSource.description: Verified geological or named water source location.

fermentation.description: Details regarding fermentation times or washback materials used.

stills.description: Still configuration particulars, sizes, styles, or unique mechanics.

peat.description: Peated or unpeated details, including PPM levels if verified.

maturation.description: Cask filling philosophy and warehousing environmental types.

houseCharacter.description: A high-density summary of the structural, verified base flavour profile.

cask23Narrative.description: The consumer-facing editorial profile focused strictly on helping a customer appreciate the whisky.

verificationDate.description: The date this profile data was QA checked and verified (YYYY-MM-DD).

evidenceTier.description: The highest quality source grading backing the technical specs.

sources.description: Verifiable links, publications, or source records utilised for the entry.

governanceStatus.description: The sign-off lifecycle state of this specific profile.
